stories.title: Heridos varios narcos tras chocar su embarcación con una patrullera de la Guardia Civil en Adra, en Almería

en.title: Several drug traffickers injured after their vessel collides with Civil Guard patrol boat in Adra, Almería
en.summary: Five people were arrested after a drug trafficking boat collided with a Civil Guard maritime patrol vessel off the coast of Adra in Almería. The patrol agents were unharmed, but several occupants of the drug boat sustained injuries.

stories.title: El ministro de Cultura de Israel amenaza con retirar la nacionalidad a los directores del documental 'Naza'

en.title: Israel's Culture Minister threatens to revoke nationality of 'NAZA' documentary directors
en.summary: Israel's Culture Minister Miki Zohar called for stripping nationality from documentary filmmakers Yuval Abraham and Rachel Szor, accusing them of treason for their award-winning film about the Israeli military's use of artificial intelligence in Gaza.

stories.title: Cinco detenidos y varios heridos tras al embestir una narcolancha a una patrullera de la Guardia Civil en Almería

en.title: Five arrested and several injured after drug boat rams Civil Guard patrol vessel in Almería
en.summary: Five individuals were detained following an incident where a drug trafficking boat collided with a Civil Guard patrol boat in Almería, with several people wounded in the collision.

stories.title: Un incendio en Benahavís deja 50 desalojados, tres heridos y un pueblo confinado en Málaga

en.title: Fire in Benahavís leaves 50 evacuated, three injured and a town confined in Málaga
en.summary: A forest fire that broke out in the Málaga municipality of Benahavís forced the evacuation of 50 residents and confined an entire town. Wind gusts up to 50 kilometers per hour spread the flames, injuring three people.

stories.title: Cinco detenidos y varios heridos al embestir una narcolancha a una patrullera en Almería

en.title: Five arrested and several injured when drug smuggling boat rams patrol vessel in Almería
en.summary: A drug smuggling boat collided with a patrol vessel in Almería, resulting in five arrests and multiple injuries. At least two injured persons were evacuated to a hospital in El Ejido.

stories.title: El ministro de Cultura de Israel pedirá la retirada de la nacionalidad de los directores del premiado documental sobre la matanza en Gaza

en.title: Israel's Culture Minister to seek revocation of citizenship for award-winning Gaza documentary directors
en.summary: Israel's Culture Minister announced plans to strip citizenship from the directors of a documentary about civilian deaths in Gaza that won an award at the Venice Film Festival.

stories.title: El Ministro de Cultura de Israel amenaza con retirarles la ciudadanía a los dos directores del documental ‘NAZA’, premiado en Venecia

en.title: Israel's Culture Minister threatens to revoke citizenship of two directors of documentary 'NAZA' awarded in Venice
en.summary: Israel's Culture Minister threatened to revoke citizenship from the two directors of the documentary 'NAZA', which won recognition at Venice and features testimonies from military personnel regarding civilian deaths in Gaza.

stories.title: Tres heridos y 50 desalojados en el incendio de Benahavís, que avanza hacia Pujerra

en.title: Three injured and 50 evacuated in Benahavís fire advancing toward Pujerra
en.summary: A fire in Benahavís resulted in three injuries, including burn wounds and injuries to a forest firefighter, and forced the evacuation of 50 people as the blaze moved toward Pujerra.

stories.title: Código rojo en la IA: el vértigo paraliza a las tecnológicas y OpenAI suspende la salida a Bolsa

en.title: Red alert in AI: vertigo paralyzes tech companies and OpenAI suspends IPO
en.summary: Following concerning incidents, OpenAI leaders Altman and Amodei advocate slowing AI model development. Trump downplays the risks, instead warning that China poses the greater threat.

stories.title: El CEO de OpenAI se une a la alarma sobre una extinción por la inteligencia artificial y retrasa su salida a bolsa

en.title: OpenAI CEO joins alarm over artificial intelligence extinction risk and delays IPO
en.summary: Sam Altman announced OpenAI will not go public this year due to safety concerns in the artificial intelligence sector, citing the inadvisability of an IPO given current conditions.

stories.title: Sam Altman paraliza la salida a bolsa de OpenAI ante los riesgos de la IA

en.title: Sam Altman halts OpenAI's IPO amid AI risks
en.summary: OpenAI's chief executive ruled out a near-term stock market debut for the ChatGPT creator, following a competitor's call to slow AI development to maintain control.

stories.title: Sam Altman descarta la salida a Bolsa de OpenAI en 2026: "Dada la situación actual en materia de seguridad, no sería el momento adecuado"

en.title: Sam Altman rules out OpenAI's stock market debut in 2026: "Given the current situation regarding safety, it would not be the right moment"
en.summary: OpenAI's chief executive has stated the company will not pursue an initial public offering in 2026, citing current safety considerations as a limiting factor.

stories.title: Los hutíes toman el sur de Yemen y amenazan el paso por Bab el-Mandeb

en.title: Houthis take southern Yemen and threaten passage through Bab el-Mandeb
en.summary: Yemeni Houthi rebels captured the port of Mokha and Perim Island in recent days, blocking Saudi oil exports to Asian markets through a strategic waterway.

stories.title: García Munté sube el beneficio un 9% y abre una filial en Dinamarca

en.title: García Munté increases profit by 9% and opens subsidiary in Denmark
en.summary: The Catalan solid fuels group achieved revenue of 725 million euros and net profit of 22 million euros in 2025, while expanding its biomass operations in the Nordic market through a new Danish subsidiary.

stories.title: Trump: EEUU saldrá de Irán "a no ser que decida quedarse por el petróleo, como en Venezuela"

en.title: Trump: US will exit Iran "unless it decides to stay for oil, like in Venezuela"
en.summary: President Trump stated he spoke with Ukrainian President Zelenski requesting that Ukraine stop attacking Russian refineries, citing concerns about diesel shortages caused by such attacks.

stories.title: Madrid supera su primer gran examen de Fórmula 1

en.title: Madrid passes its first major Formula 1 exam
en.summary: Andrea Kimi Antonelli won the inaugural Formula 1 race at MADRING, beating Max Verstappen and Lando Norris, marking the championship's return to Madrid after 45 years with sold-out attendance and a planned decade-long commitment.

stories.title: Las medidas fiscales por la guerra en Irán restan 1.812 millones a la recaudación hasta julio

en.title: Fiscal measures for Iran war cost 1.812 billion in lost revenue through July
en.summary: Spain's Treasury has foregone 1.812 billion euros in tax revenue through July due to fiscal measures introduced in March to mitigate the economic impact of Middle East conflict.
